name: Potentially Suspicious Wuauclt Network Connection
description:
Detects the use of the Windows Update Client binary (wuauclt.exe) to proxy execute code and making network connections.
One could easily make the DLL spawn a new process and inject to it to proxy the network connection and bypass this rule.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*wuauclt* AND winlog.event_data.CommandLine:*\ \/RunHandlerComServer*) AND (NOT ((destination.ip:127.0.0.0\/8 OR destination.ip:10.0.0.0\/8 OR destination.ip:169.254.0.0\/16 OR destination.ip:172.16.0.0\/12 OR destination.ip:192.168.0.0\/16 OR destination.ip:\:\:1\/128 OR destination.ip:fe80\:\:\/10 OR destination.ip:fc00\:\:\/7) OR (destination.ip:20.184.0.0\/13 OR destination.ip:20.192.0.0\/10 OR destination.ip:23.79.0.0\/16 OR destination.ip:51.10.0.0\/15 OR destination.ip:51.103.0.0\/16 OR destination.ip:51.104.0.0\/15 OR destination.ip:52.224.0.0\/11) OR (winlog.event_data.CommandLine:(*\:\\Windows\\UUS\\Packages\\Preview\\amd64\\updatedeploy.dll\ \/ClassId* OR *\:\\Windows\\UUS\\amd64\\UpdateDeploy.dll\ \/ClassId*)) OR (winlog.event_data.CommandLine:*\:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\* AND winlog.event_data.CommandLine:*\\UpdateDeploy.dll\ \/ClassId\ *) OR (NOT _exists_:winlog.event_data.CommandLine) OR winlog.event_data.CommandLine:""))
